source.description: Input load/copy point where attacker-controlled PoC bytes are copied into the FLAC decoder read buffer.
source.value_from: Copies bytes derived from the PoC datasource into the decoder input buffer used by the FLAC bitreader.; value `buffer`; from `memcpy(buffer, data.data(), copySize);`

sink.description: ASan crash location: a 4-byte read from br->buffer[cwords] past the allocated bitreader buffer.

root_cause.description: The Rice residual tail path reads br->buffer[cwords] without checking that cwords is within the bitreader buffer capacity.

tainted_value_origin.description: The residual Rice parameter and subsequent encoded residual bits are parsed from attacker-controlled FLAC frame data.

coarse_trace.summary: Copies attacker-controlled bytes into the FLAC decoder input buffer.
Processes the attacker-controlled stream through frame and subframe decoding.
Parses partitioned Rice residual metadata and values.
Advances bitreader word indices and reads past the buffer when cwords reaches capacity.

fine_trace.note: The callback is the input load/copy point for this libFuzzer target: PoC bytes are copied into the FLAC decoder buffer.
The core FLAC decoder invokes the registered read callback, so bytes copied by FuzzerStream become bitreader input.
Residual coding metadata is read from the attacker-controlled bitstream.
The parsed Rice parameter and sample count drive block residual decoding.
The bitreader word index reflects how far attacker-controlled residual parsing has advanced through the buffer.
The vulnerable read uses cwords as an index without a cwords < br->capacity guard. The patch adds this guard and substitutes 0 when the index is outside capacity.
ASan reports a heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 4 at this buffer access.
